confidence_scope: Frozen finite numerical support subpool, exported directed-oracle costs, independently checked CSV/sample-base geometry and deterministic shared NN recovery only.
review_scope_note: Independent AI reviewer and independently implemented Python auditor; not human peer review, independently solved IK/A*, continuous collision validation or physical execution.
what_results_support: In this fixed default 16-table/36-task main scene, all four methods retain full numerical task support and 16 subpool-minimum stops, while joint local search lowers both actual raw path length and the stated weighted navigation objective in all three profiles.

Independent regional DP and cover-count reconstruction certify one stop per table on the common 906-candidate support subpool. Staged already attains this count; minimum-seed repair adds no gain in this run.

Reorder-only retains the same repaired seed dock set. Joint dock/visit-order coupling improves beyond its observed objective, without implying an isolated replacement effect or equal-compute superiority.

All accepted changes strictly descend the repriced exported directed-oracle objective; actual final paths return to start, visit ordered docks/headings and pass independent sampled physical-base geometry checks.
Full directed matrices reproduce the shared first-finite NN protocol and preserve the original failed initial trial without NaN percentage comparisons.
Main-scene figures faithfully use the actual 16-table map, all 36 task points, exported routes and physical dock footprints/headings.
what_results_dont_support: Global navigation optimality, local optimality of the three max_passes joint runs, or a minimum count over the entire dense candidate pool or continuous workspace.
Algorithm novelty, general superiority, statistical significance, scaling complexity, equal-compute superiority or end-to-end planning speedup from a single deterministic scene.
A claim that posture constraints necessarily increase stop count: all profiles use 16 here, despite their different numerical support matrices.

Attributing the common direction/invalid-edge/finite-NN protocol correction to joint selection, comparing final finite costs against archived NaN failures, or treating finite-search failure as physical infeasibility.
Treating endpoint-yaw cost as integrated turning effort, time or energy, or treating search callback/memo counts as all actual navigation planner calls.
Independent IK/A* replication, arm/self/inter-arm/transition/swept collision, contact force, calibrated hardware or physical grasp/wipe success.
missing_evidence: Held-out layouts/seeds, candidate-density and task-direction studies before generalization claims.
IK-budget/solver and candidate-subsampling sensitivity before broader workspace or impossibility claims.
Equal-budget strong navigation-aware controls and component ablations for method-level superiority.
Full cost accounting, controlled cache conditions and repeated timings for efficiency claims.
Calibrated collision-aware arm/transition and physical/contact validation for execution claims.
suggested_claim_revision: 在默认16桌、36个原始任务及同一VX300s模型上，针对统一冻结的906候选数值支持子池，联合停靠/访问序列局部搜索保持36/36任务支持和16次子池最少停靠。相对共同导航修复后的分阶段方法，三任务的加权导航代价降低21.55%、14.12%、19.34%，实际路径缩短21.82%、15.27%、19.38%；相对固定停靠集合重排，加权代价再降低12.28%、4.69%、9.77%。这些是单场景有限预算的观察结果，三个联合搜索均因max_passes停止，不作全局或局部最优、普遍优势和实机成功主张。
next_experiments_needed_for_broader_clai: Equal-budget stronger navigation-aware controls and component ablations
Complete repeated computational accounting under controlled cache conditions
Independent collision-aware arm/transition and physical validation
